$description: Grapho design tokens, W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. The single source for every shell. See tokens/README.md.

pairs.reason: Two-tone: the ring or the gap must contrast with the background, and they contrast with each other.
White handle with a dark edge: one of the two always contrasts with the page.
border/strong resolves to text/muted under more contrast; the sheet and dialog edge is graded here.
Decorative separator; the check badge itself passes against its fill.
Loading placeholder shape; the loading label carries the meaning.
Decorative separators and banner edges. Errors use border/error, banners carry text and an icon.

grey.$description: Cool neutral. Ink surfaces and text, plus the neutral text and surface steps of every light theme.

slate.$description: Graphite dark: lifted blacks with a little blue.

umber.$description: Paper dark: warm near-black surfaces and warm text.

charcoal.$description: Pen wheel instrument greys. The wheel is a fixed dark object and does not follow the theme.

red.$description: Danger. 300 is text on dark, 700 is text on light, 500 is the brand red, 600 is the solid fill.

green.$description: Success. 300 text on dark, 500 brand green and tint base, 700 text on light.

gold.$description: Warning. 400 is brand gold, 800 is text on light.

blue.$description: Info. 300 text on dark, 500 brand blue and tint base, 700 text on light.

transparent.$description: Fully transparent, the rest state of quiet controls.

page.$description: Note page colours. Content, not chrome. The first five are the page colours a person can pick; warm and mist are the default page of Ink dark and Graphite dark.

ink.$description: Default handwriting on a light page.

on-dark.$description: Default handwriting on a dark page.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

dark.$description: Tag chip text on dark themes.

light.$description: Tag chip text on light themes.

alpha.$description: Translucent tints. The first part of the name is the base colour, the last is the opacity in percent. Rendered over any surface.

sans.$description: Geist everywhere. Noto Sans Devanagari carries Hindi, which Geist lacks. Shells use the platform lists in the grapho extension of semantic font/sans.

hand.$description: Handwriting face. Only as ink on covers and canvases, never in chrome.

112.$description: Unitless multiplier. A line box is never shorter than 1.25 times the size for Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, and 1.5 times for Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai.

127.$description: Unitless multiplier. A line box is never shorter than 1.25 times the size for Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, and 1.5 times for Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai.

129.$description: Unitless multiplier. A line box is never shorter than 1.25 times the size for Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, and 1.5 times for Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai.

133.$description: Unitless multiplier. A line box is never shorter than 1.25 times the size for Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, and 1.5 times for Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai.

138.$description: Unitless multiplier. A line box is never shorter than 1.25 times the size for Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, and 1.5 times for Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai.

143.$description: Unitless multiplier. A line box is never shorter than 1.25 times the size for Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, and 1.5 times for Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai.

147.$description: Unitless multiplier. A line box is never shorter than 1.25 times the size for Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, and 1.5 times for Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai.

display.$description: Latin, Cyrillic and Greek only. Joining and abugida scripts (Devanagari, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai) always use 0.

neg-2.$description: Inset adjustment, used by the inset focus ring.

instant.$description: Reduced motion. The CSS generator writes 0.01ms so transitions still end and end states apply.

cover.$description: Width over height of a cover: 3 by 4.

primitive.$description: Tier 1. Raw palette and raw scales. Components and screens never read these.

sans.$description: Family for all chrome and body text.

label.$description: Buttons, menu items, tiles, chips. The one label size at every control height.

micro.$description: Counts and badges. The smallest text in the product. Never for text a person must read to act.

key.$description: Key caps, page chips, tiny marks.

item.$description: Menu items, swatch squares, cover outer corner.

pill.$description: Buttons, toggles, dots. Buttons are pills.

focus.$description: Width of the focus gap and of the focus ring.

fast.$description: Hover, selection slide, small state change.

chrome-recede.$description: Chrome receding when the pen touches the page (system/document.md). The page does not reflow.

chrome-return.$description: Chrome returning, ease out, after a tap at the top edge or 1.5 s without pen contact.

canvas.$description: The page and everything drawn on it.

chrome.$description: Top bar, tool row, dock, rails, banners.

floating-bar.$description: Floating note bar and selection bar.

wheel.$description: The pen wheel. Opens at the pen tip above the dock and floating bars.

panel.$description: Panels beside or over the page that keep it live.

scrim.$description: Scrim behind drawer, sheet and dialog. Each modal level draws its own just below itself.

popover.$description: Menus and popovers. Above dialogs because they open from inside sheets and dialogs.

palette.$description: Command search. Runs on every screen, so it sits over sheets and dialogs.

drag-ghost.$description: The item that follows the pointer while dragging.

small.$description: Small control. Touch 36, compact 28. Dense repeated rows only. Its layout slot is still at least size/hit/min.

default.$description: Default control. Touch 44, compact 36. Buttons, selects, fields, tabs, segmented controls, menu triggers.

large.$description: Large control. Touch 52, compact 44. The single primary action of a sheet, dialog or first run screen.

min.$description: Smallest layout slot an interactive thing may occupy. Touch 44, compact 24 (WCAG 2.5.8). Reserved in layout, not an invisible overlap. At touch density it resolves to size/hit/touch.

touch.$description: Minimum touch hit target: 44 on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Windows and the web, 48 on Android (Material).

top.$description: Top bar and tool row. Holds default controls. Touch 52, compact 48.

note.$description: Full line note bar and the floating bar. Holds small controls. Touch 48, compact 40. The page gives this up when the bar shows.

note-max.$description: Width cap of the floating NoteBar and FindBar.

slot.$description: Pitch of one tool slot in the dock. Touch 52, compact 44. Eight to twelve slots plus undo and redo must fit 800 wide.

header.$description: Sheet and dialog header row. Touch 56, compact 48.

default.$description: Centred Sheet width, clamped to the window minus gutters.

wide.$description: Sheet width for grid bodies and Picker hosts.

list.$description: Start-side list width in a Sheet with more than five sections.
List, inspector and settings rows. Touch 52, compact 44.

menu.$description: Menu items. Touch 44 (Android 48, meeting size/hit/touch), compact 36.

height.$description: Switch track height. Touch 32, compact 24. The slot around it is size/hit/min.

checkbox.$description: Checkbox and radio box. Touch 24, compact 20. The slot around it is size/hit/min.

track.$description: Slider track thickness. The same at both densities; the slot around it is size/hit/min.

keycap.$description: Key cap height in shortcut hints and the ShortcutField. Touch 24, compact 20.

dot.$description: Diameter of the attention Dot on an IconButton or row.

width-narrow.$description: Width of a Popover that holds a single control. Equals size/tooltip/max-width.

max-height.$description: Maximum height of a popover before it scrolls.

min-width.$description: Shortest a menu may be, so short menus stay readable.

max-width.$description: Widest a menu may be: two lines of German labels on a 600 dp window.

width.$description: Command search width, about 60 characters of command name.

max-height.$description: Command search maximum height, the same as size/popover/max-height.

small.$description: Picker tile preview, small: image tile small.

medium.$description: Picker tile preview, medium: swatch, page thumbnail, image tile medium.

large.$description: Picker tile preview, large: cover, template. Three by four.

wide-width.$description: Wide preview width: pen sample, theme preview.

min.$description: Smallest library tile, padding included. Sets the column count; two columns fit a 360 window.

meta-min.$description: Below this tile width page count and time are dropped.

crop.$description: Height of an ink crop in handwriting search hits.

row.$description: Pack art and mini cover in a row. Touch 40, compact 32.

hub-radius.$description: Pens hub radius: half the diagonal of a 3 by 2 grid of size/hit/touch cells plus the label line and a divider. 90 at 44, 96 at 48.

outer-radius.$description: Wheel disc radius: hub plus two rings of size/hit/touch plus dividers. 186 at 44, 198 at 48.

margin.$description: Distance of the wheel from the window edge.

min-window.$description: Below this the wheel is the menu form: outer diameter plus twice the margin. 404 at 44, 428 at 48.

handle-height.$description: Visual height of the scrubber handle.

width-compact.$description: Minimap width in the compact class.

viewport-min.$description: Smallest viewport rectangle in the minimap.

actions-min.$description: Placeholder width below which its actions move into a Menu.

text-min.$description: Minimum Banner text column before its actions stack.

label-min.$description: Minimum label column of an inline field row (Slider) before it stacks.

width.$description: SidePanel width when beside the page.

width-over.$description: SidePanel width when over the page.

max.$description: SidePanel resize maximum, clamped by size/page/min-width.

min.$description: Page height kept above a bottom panel.

min-width.$description: Page width kept beside a panel.

edge-guard.$description: Distance a canvas SelectionBar keeps from the window edge.

max-width.$description: Tooltip maximum width; longer text wraps.

small.$description: Icon in a small control. Touch 18, compact 16.

default.$description: Icon in a default control. Touch 20, compact 18.

large.$description: Icon in a large control. Touch 24, compact 20.

inline.$description: Icon set in a line of text. Scales with text size: 1.1 times the line height of the style it sits in, never below 16.

feature.$description: Large glyph in an empty state toolbar or a tile with no label.

typeahead.$description: Typeahead prefix reset in menus and lists.

progress.$description: A job past this becomes a progress item.

spinner.$description: Wait before an inline busy indicator shows.

tooltip.$description: Hover or focus wait before a tooltip.

long-list.$description: Items above which the rail and Filter appear.

skeleton.$description: Minimum time a skeleton stays once shown.

touch-tooltip.$description: Long press time that shows a tooltip on touch.

screen-reader.$description: Minimum time a toast stays when a screen reader is running.

load.$description: Core default for a load timeout; hosts may override.

recent-max.$description: Entries kept in the activity list.

cover.$description: Cover, PDF and folder art: width over height, 3 by 4.

duration.$description: Longest contact that counts as a tap (edge tap, finger and mouse).
Longest finger tap on chrome under the palm rule.

travel.$description: Farthest a finger tap on chrome may move.

palm-threshold.$description: Contact size treated as a palm, in dp across. A proposal: each shell sets it per platform.

snap-undo.$description: How long the snap Undo chip stays.

live-settle.$description: Live region and scrubber render settle.

palm-window.$description: The palm rule window after a palm-sized contact.

hover-recall.$description: Pen hover at the top edge before chrome returns.

pen-idle.$description: Pen idle time before a toast or banner appears over the page, and before the note bar returns.

scrubber-min-pages.$description: Pages above which the scrubber exists.

minimap-reach.$description: Viewports of clip distance shown by the minimap.

short.$description: Height below which the short window rule applies.

medium.$description: Width class boundary: compact below, medium from here. Documented only, CSS cannot read custom properties in media queries.

expanded.$description: Width class boundary: expanded from here.

empty.$description: Text measure of an empty state, independent of any height.

compact.$description: Screen side padding in the compact width class.

medium.$description: Screen side padding in the medium width class.

expanded.$description: Screen side padding in the expanded width class.

px16.$description: Stroke in 24 grid units for an icon drawn at 16. Optical: the rendered width is stroke times 16 over 24.

px18.$description: Stroke in 24 grid units for an icon drawn at 18. Optical: the rendered width is stroke times 18 over 24.

px20.$description: Stroke in 24 grid units for an icon drawn at 20. Optical: the rendered width is stroke times 20 over 24.

px24.$description: Stroke in 24 grid units for an icon drawn at 24. Optical: the rendered width is stroke times 24 over 24.

px32.$description: Stroke in 24 grid units for an icon drawn at 32. Optical: the rendered width is stroke times 32 over 24.

source-opacity.$description: Opacity of the item being dragged, left in place.

target-fill.$description: Fill of a valid drop target.

target-line.$description: Outline of a valid drop target. 3:1.

insertion.$description: The line showing where a dragged item will land. 3:1.

fg.$description: Text in a read-only field. Passes AA.

bg.$description: Read-only field fill: quieter than an editable control.
Danger tint behind text or an icon.

bg-pressed.$description: Danger tint while pressed, for quiet danger buttons.

solid.$description: Solid danger fill, the hold-to-confirm fill.

raised.$description: App screens such as the library and settings, and cards that sit on base.

control-hover.$description: A control or row under the pointer.

strong.$description: Inner wells and the pressed step of a control.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, dialogs and sheets. Always opaque.

sunken.$description: The stage behind the note page. Page numbers, zoom and rulers sit here.

subtle.$description: Meta, labels and placeholders. Restricted: see the usage rules in tokens/README.md.

disabled.$description: Disabled text. Exempt from contrast by WCAG 1.4.3.

subtle.$description: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative.

strong.$description: Stronger hairline around floating surfaces. Decorative: shadow and surface step separate them.

control.$description: Edge of an unchecked checkbox, radio or field. 3:1 on every chrome surface.

focus.$description: The outer ring of the focus indicator. Always text/default, never the accent.

focus-gap.$description: The inner gap of the focus indicator, in the surface colour, so the ring has contrast against any background.

error.$description: Solid edge of a field in error. 3:1.

warning.$description: Solid edge of a field with a warning. 3:1.

bg.$description: The solid button and the on state of switches and sliders. The accent in custom themes.

fg.$description: Text and icons on the primary action.

bg.$description: Icon button and text button at rest: no fill.

fg-on.$description: Icon colour of a toggled-on icon button, drawn on selection/fill.

bg-pressed.$description: Pressed fill of a glass IconButton over artwork.

fill.$description: The chosen tile, segment, chip or row. Always paired with selection/indicator.

fill-hover.$description: The chosen item under the pointer.

indicator.$description: Check mark, leading bar or outline that marks the chosen item. 3:1 on the fill. Fill alone never marks selection.

media-ring.$description: Selection on an image, cover or PDF page: a white ring.

media-halo.$description: Dark halo drawn round selection/media-ring so it shows on light and dark pixels.

fill.$description: A tile, row or segment under the pointer.

track.$description: Empty part of a progress bar.

fill.$description: Filled part of a progress bar. 3:1 on the track and on its host.

placeholder-bg.$description: Placeholder for missing content on the page: fill.

placeholder-text.$description: Placeholder text, over its fill on the page.

ink-default.$description: Default handwriting on the page. At least 7:1 on canvas/page.

rule.$description: Ruled lines and grid on the page. Decorative.

selection-fill.$description: Selection rectangle fill on the page.

content.$description: Page content in the minimap. 3:1 on media/glass over a white page.

viewport.$description: The viewport rectangle in the minimap. 3:1 on media/glass over a white page.

handle.$description: Fill of a selection handle on the page. Always drawn with canvas/handle-edge.

handle-edge.$description: Dark edge round a white handle, so it shows on any page colour.

marquee.$description: Lasso and marquee line on the page. 3:1 on the default pages.

guide.$description: Ruler and protractor edge on the page.

stacked.$description: Behind a dialog that opens over a sheet, lighter so two scrims do not stack to near black.

soft.$description: Colour of the soft shadow layer of floating surfaces.

deep.$description: Colour of the deep shadow layer of sheets and dialogs.

thumb.$description: Colour of the shadow under a slider or segmented thumb.

fg.$description: Text of a red tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a red tag chip.

fg.$description: Text of a orange tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a orange tag chip.

fg.$description: Text of a yellow tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a yellow tag chip.

fg.$description: Text of a green tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a green tag chip.

fg.$description: Text of a teal tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a teal tag chip.

fg.$description: Text of a blue tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a blue tag chip.

fg.$description: Text of a violet tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a violet tag chip.

fg.$description: Text of a pink tag chip. A chrome tint, not a user ink colour.

bg.$description: Fill of a pink tag chip.

check-empty-bg.$description: Disc behind an empty check on art. Always drawn with media/halo.

veil.$description: Over a picture while it is being worked on.

crop-dim.$description: The part of a picture outside the crop frame.

text.$description: Glyphs and text over artwork. Fixed: artwork is scrimmed dark, in every theme.

chip.$description: Round button over artwork, such as folder dots.

glass.$description: Play glyph and badges on artwork.

edge.$description: Inner edge on a cover. Decorative.

ring.$description: Press ring of a glass control over artwork. 3:1 on the glass fills.

pink.$description: Brand colours live in content and in the tail gradient, never in chrome.

tail.$description: The tail gradient: progress and one drawn underline, the only brand colour in chrome.

white.$description: The five page colours a person can pick for a note. Content, not chrome, so no theme changes them.

ink-on-dark.$description: Default handwriting on a dark page colour.

bar.$description: The floating note bar: a whisper, so the page stays the loudest thing.

popover.$description: Menus and popovers. Drawn with a border/subtle hairline.

sheet.$description: Sheets and dialogs. Flat surfaces have no shadow, so there is no flat token.

thumb.$description: Slider knob and the sliding segmented thumb.

drag.$description: The dragged item lifted off the page.

wheel.$description: The pen wheel floating over the page.

semantic.$description: Tier 2. Meaning. Components read these. Default values are the Ink dark theme.

width.$description: Inner gap of the two-tone focus indicator, drawn in the surface colour.

color.$description: Components set this to the colour of the surface they sit on. The default is surface/base.

width.$description: Outer ring of the focus indicator. One recipe for every control; components never set their own outline.

color.$description: Always text/default. Never the accent, so a user theme cannot hide it.

ring.$description: The pen wheel is a fixed dark instrument over any page, so these bands do not change with the theme. Outer edge of the wheel body and the tool well.

swatch-edge.$description: Edge of a colour swatch on the wheel: 3:1 on the plate; a white swatch is separated by the ring.

swatch-ring.$description: Ring round the selected swatch, with a gap in wheel/plate.

nib-well.$description: A light disc behind a nib so black nibs show on charcoal.

body.$description: The wheel disc under the bands. Fixed dark; it does not follow the theme.

well.$description: Tools band, recessed; also the dark fields inside panels.

grip.$description: Handle, closed tab and the card under the pointer.

scroll-track.$description: Track of the scroll marker on the tool band edge.

glyph-ring.$description: Hairline ring on the size button.

checker-dark.$description: Dark square of the checker under the opacity arc.

checker-light.$description: Light square of the checker under the opacity arc.

field.$description: A text field or card on the wheel at rest.

field-focus.$description: Edge of a focused field on the wheel.

edge.$description: Hairline round a swatch, a field or the hint disc on the wheel.

thumb-edge.$description: Dark halo round a thumb on a colour bar or square, so a light thumb shows on a light colour.

check-bg.$description: Check badge fill on art and swatches. The halo separates it from any art.

halo.$description: Two pixel ring round the badge. Tiles set it to the colour of the surface they sit on, like focus/gap/color. Decorative.

cover-neutral-fg.$description: Icon on a missing cover. 3:1 on the above in every variant.

thumb-off.$description: Switch thumb when off. 3:1 on the off track.

track-on.$description: Switch track when on: a tint of the text colour, not the accent and not action/primary. 3:1 on its host.

thumb-on.$description: Switch thumb when on. 3:1 on the on track.

width-max.$description: Toast width is min(this, viewport width minus two gutters). A toast holds an Undo button and one line.

gap-above-bar.$description: Gap between a toast and a selection bar or floating bar below it.

bottom.$description: Distance from the bottom edge of the one line pill toast.

duration-undo.$description: Minimum time an Undo toast stays. Shells use the larger of this and the system accessibility timeout, and never dismiss a toast that has focus or a pointer on it. Reading time, not animation, so reduced motion does not shorten it.

duration-plain.$description: Minimum time of a toast without an action, with the same system timeout rule.

component.$description: Tier 3. Only where a component needs a value no semantic token describes.

ink.$description: Default theme family. Calm greys, no hue.

dark.$description: Ink dark: the default theme. Near-black, OLED friendly. Its values are the defaults of the semantic group, so it has no override block.

light.$description: Ink light: the neutral light variant of Ink. Crisp grey and white, no hue.

dark.$description: Graphite dark: a softer dark with lifted blacks and a blue cast.

light.$description: Graphite light: a cool blue-grey light theme with blue tinted surfaces and text.
Paper light: warm sand surfaces and warm brown-grey text, like a notebook on a desk.

dark.$description: Paper dark: warm near-black with warm cream text, for night use of Paper.

themes.$description: Semantic overrides only. A theme variant is a map from semantic token to a primitive alias (or, for user themes, a literal colour). Every non-default variant must override every themable token.
